description: Rent a virtual phone number via the Platfone API for the given country and service category. Returns phone number, activation_id, resolved country & service names, price, expiry time, retriable flag, and whether/when the activation can be canceled. Accepts country and service as human-readable names or IDs — names are auto-resolved from the cached catalog. Use check_price first to verify cost and availability. Use check_sms with the activation_id to poll for incoming SMS. Only received messages are billed. IMPORTANT: Only call this tool once per order. Never call it multiple times in parallel — duplicate orders will be rejected.

max_price.description: Maximum price in USD cents you're willing to pay. Protects against price changes.

quality_factor.description: Quality vs price preference: 0 = cheapest, 50 = balanced (default), 100 = highest quality.

service.description: Service category name or ID from the Platfone catalog.
